Name: Shared Fridge With Spouse
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages:[/b] English（English description below）, 简体中文

[color=#e06666]代码大部分是ai写的，有经过测试。创意是自己想的，也有网友提议的，非常感谢。
AI tools were used to write the code. I designed and tested the mod myself, with some ideas from the community. [/color]

[b][size=5]Shared Fridge With Spouse 和伴侣共享冰箱[/size][/b]

你有没有想过把冰箱里的食物分享给伴侣呢？
现在，你的伴侣（配偶或是室友）会从家里的冰箱里拿走他们喜欢的可食用物品。食物被拿走后，打开冰箱时会显示当天提示，也可以通过冰箱上方的历史记录按钮查看最近的消耗记录。（历史记录最多保留50条）
消耗食物会增加好感，相当于一次正常送礼，但不占用送礼次数。
消耗食物当天会有相关对话。原版可结婚对象和科罗布斯拥有符合各自性格的专属台词。其他 npc 也可正常使用，有通用台词。

[b][size=4]使用[/size][/b]
打开自家冰箱，点击上方按钮即可查看便签、历史记录、委托采购或选择喜欢的菜。也可以按 [b]F10[/b] 打开总菜单。

[b][size=4]冰箱便签[/size][/b]
伴侣偶尔会在冰箱上留下便签，可打开冰箱点击便签按钮查看。
有未读便签时，按钮会显示红点。
有些便签只是日常留言；有些会请求一种食物或者料理食材。如果你选择答应请求，并且冰箱里有放入对应物品，第二天伴侣会使用它，并留下一张感谢便签。
忽略便签不会扣好感或产生惩罚。

[b][size=4]1.4.0 新增：伴侣做菜[/size][/b]
打开冰箱，点击“喜欢的菜”按钮可以选择你爱吃的菜肴。之后，每位伴侣或室友每天都有概率制作其中一道，并放入冰箱。
默认概率为 [b]25%[/b]，不会消耗原料。成功后会写入历史记录，并在交谈时出现相关对话。

[b][size=4]2.0.0 新增：委托伴侣采购[/size][/b]
点击冰箱上方的“采购”按钮，可以委托伴侣采购食物（目前只能购买杂货店或餐吧的）。确认付款后，伴侣会在第二天早晨把食物放进冰箱。

[b][size=4]2.0.0 新增：禁止或允许共享[/size][/b]
默认共享自家屋内和地窖的所有冰箱，可用冰箱上方的锁图标选择哪些冰箱禁止/允许伴侣使用。

[b][size=4]主要配置（2.0.0）[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]每日取用食物概率：默认 100%。[/*]
[*]每日便签生成概率： 默认 40%。[/*]
[*]冰箱搜索范围：主厨房冰箱（MainKitchenOnly）或屋内及地窖所有冰箱（AllHouseFridges，默认）。[/*]
[*]每种物品保留数量：默认保留 0 份。[/*]
[*]允许取用喜欢的食物：默认关闭。[/*]
[*]允许扣减能量食物：默认关闭；开启后可支持科罗布斯等 NPC 的特殊喜好。[/*]
[*]请求菜肴只使用已学会菜谱：默认关闭。[/*]
[*]保护高价食物：默认关闭。[/*]
[*]高价食物最低金额：默认 1000g。[/*]
[*]打开冰箱时显示取用提示：默认开启。[/*]
[*]伴侣每日做饭概率：默认 25%。[/*]
[*]总菜单快捷键：默认 F10。[/*]
[*]冰箱按钮组的水平与垂直位置。[/*]
[/list]配置可通过 config.json 修改，也支持 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]。

[b][size=4]兼容性[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]支持多婚/多伴侣，会识别所有已婚或室友 NPC （已测试 PolyamorySweet）。[/*]
[*]支持自定义 NPC，只要该 NPC  能像其他村民一样结婚或成为室友，并且有自己的礼物喜好数据。[/*]
[*]1.3.2版本以后兼容安卓版（部分功能需要使用虚拟键盘）[/*]
[*]各功能菜单支持手柄操作。[/*]
[/list] 

[b][size=4]English[/size][/b]
Have you ever thought about sharing the food in your fridge with your partner?
Now, your spouse or roommate will take edible items they like from your home fridges. After food is taken, a notification will appear the next time you open the fridge. You can also check recent consumption records using the history button above the fridge. (The history keeps a maximum of 50 entries)
Eating food increases friendship, just like a normal gift, but does not count toward the daily or weekly gift limit.
On days when food is consumed, there will be related dialogue. The vanilla marriage candidates and Krobus have unique lines tailored to their individual personalities, while other modded NPCs are also fully supported and will use generic dialogue.

[b][size=4]Getting Started[/size][/b]
Open your home fridge and use the buttons above it to read notes, view history, ask your partner to shop, or choose your favorite dishes. You can also press [b]F10[/b] to open the main menu.

[b][size=4]Fridge Notes[/size][/b]
Your spouse may occasionally leave a note on the fridge. Open the fridge and click the note button to read it.
A red dot on the note button means there are unread notes.
Some notes are simple daily messages, while others may request a food item or an ingredient for tomorrow’s cooking. If you choose to accept the request and the matching item is in the fridge, your spouse will use it the next day and leave a thank-you note.
Ignoring a note will not reduce friendship or cause any penalty.

[b][size=4]New in 1.4.0: Partner Cooking[/size][/b]
Click the “Favorite dishes” button above the fridge to select dishes you enjoy. Each spouse or roommate then has an independent daily chance to cook one of them and place it in the fridge.
The default chance is [b]25%[/b]. Cooking uses no ingredients. Successful dishes are added to the fridge history and can trigger dialogue.

[b][size=4]New in 2.0.0: Ask Your Partner to Shop[/size][/b]
Click “Buy groceries” above the fridge to ask your partner to buy food (currently only from Pierre’s or the Saloon). After you confirm and pay, your partner will put the food in the fridge the next morning.

[b][size=4]New in 2.0.0: Allow or Block Sharing[/size][/b]
By default, all fridges inside your home and cellar are shared. Use the lock icon above each fridge to choose which ones your partner can use.

[b][size=4]Config Options (2.0.0)[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Daily food consumption chance: 100% by default.[/*]
[*]Daily note generation chance:  40% by default.[/*]
[*]Fridge search scope: main kitchen or all fridge chests inside your farmhouse and its cellar (default).[/*]
[*]Reserved stock per item: keeps 0 by default.[/*]
[*]Allow liked foods: disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Allow negative-energy foods: disabled by default; useful for unusual tastes such as Krobus's.[/*]
[*]Filter direct dish requests by learned recipes: disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Protect valuable foods: disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Valuable food threshold: 1000g by default.[/*]
[*]Show fridge notifications: enabled by default.[/*]
[*]Daily partner cooking chance: 25% by default.[/*]
[*]Main menu shortcut: F10 by default.[/*]
[*]Horizontal and vertical offsets for the fridge buttons.[/*]
[/list]Config can be edited through config.json, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is also supported.

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Supports multi-spouse / multi-partner setups by detecting all married or roommate NPCs. Tested with PolyamorySweet.[/*]
[*]Supports custom NPCs, as long as the NPC can marry or become a roommate like other villagers and has their own gift taste data.[/*]
[*]Android compatibility is supported in version 1.3.2 and later.  [/*]
[*]All feature menus support controllers.[/*]
[/list]
